executive_summary: Compare shared order-arena and radix price storage with the unchanged native baseline on four focused markets; four additional controls check matching semantics.

selection_rationale.t3-mr-deep-book-state-size: Deep resting state exercises arena capacity, sparse price lookup, level insertion and removal.
selection_rationale.t3-mp05-cancel-churn-newest: Cancellation churn stresses direct order-ID lookup, FIFO unlink and cancel-newest STP.
selection_rationale.t3-multilevel-crossing: Marketable flow crosses levels and stresses best-price replacement and FIFO partial fills.
selection_rationale.t3-s001-price-time-priority: Small FIFO reference case checks ordering and captures fixed structure overhead.
selection_rationale.t3-mp02-stp-oldest-baseline: Cancel-oldest STP must keep removing the correct resting head.
selection_rationale.t3-partialfill-atomicity: Partial fill quantities and resting-order state must remain exact.
selection_rationale.t3-s012-partial-fill-cancel-race: Cancellation requests must use exchange residual state while sent snapshots remain independent.
selection_rationale.t3-gbatch-hetero-mix: Five heterogeneous markets check independent arena lifetime and native execution per market.
